cfg.kineticchat.chat.description: Server-authoritative chat length, history storage, and signature rules. Both singleplayer and multiplayer save through the active server; editing requires permission level 2.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.compact_chat.desc: Merges consecutive identical messages and appends a count, reducing spam from system messages, mod errors, or repeated player messages.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.draggable_scrollbar: Shows a draggable scrollbar on the right side of chat for quickly browsing a large message history.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.heads.desc: Renders real-time skin avatars before chat messages. Prioritizes premium skins with automatic offline-skin fallback based on UUID.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.history_lines.desc: Maximum history lines retained by the server for each player and synchronized to clients as the display limit. Valid range is 100–100000; server storage also has a per-player size budget.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.max_length.desc: Maximum characters accepted by the chat box, packets, and commands. Vanilla uses 256; clients and servers should use matching values.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.strip_signatures.de: Controls whether the server strips chat signatures before broadcasting and synchronizes that choice to clients for the matching report and insecure-chat UI behavior.
cfg.kineticchat.chat.timestamp.desc: Shows a local timestamp with millisecond precision [HH:mm:ss.SSS] before every chat message.
gui.kineticchat.chat.back.desc: Exit capture mode and return to chat screen.
gui.kineticchat.open_canvas.desc: Open virtual canvas for scrolling, selecting, and copying full chat history.
gui.kineticchat.module.name: KineticChat
gui.kineticchat.module.tooltip: Provides chat display, copying, history, and related chat enhancements.
cfg.kineticchat.client.description: Affects only this client's display and interaction preferences. These settings are stored locally and never written to the server config.
